title: Markovian-kernel characterization of mass-stationarity
exact_target: Can mass-stationarity be characterized using preserving transport kernels that are probability kernels?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900009 (AMR-098-0009). CC BY 4.0.
